comparator.sourceNotes: The current curriculum is represented by its 45 separately credited compulsory study units totaling 150 EC, rather than ten opaque 15-EC parent labels. Genuine integrated project and academic-skills units remain intact; parents and children are never stacked. The third year preserves two generic 15-EC minor slots, Production Systems Engineering and the 12-EC research assignment plus 3-EC societal embedding.
